titre: Permis de forage initiaux au Texas
sous_titre: Nombre de permis initiaux délivrés, de janvier à juin 2026

Janv. 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 727 original drilling permits in January 2026.

Févr. 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 579 original drilling permits in February 2026.

Mars 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 692 original drilling permits in March 2026.

Avr. 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 752 original drilling permits in April 2026.

Mai 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 753 original drilling permits in May 2026.

Juin 2026.texte: The Railroad Commission of Texas issued a total of 750 original drilling permits in June 2026.
